title: The Three-Lamp Switch Dance
premise: A toy technician must turn three dark lamps on. Left toggles lamps 1 and 2, middle toggles 2 and 3, and right toggles 1 only; after noisy guesswork, the technician presses middle then right, lighting all three in exactly two presses and revealing a tiny stage.
hook: Two presses. Three lamps. Which two?
visible_action: Labeled switches depress; lamp states flip; a two-row state diagram appears; middle then right produces three lit bulbs.
intended_takeaway_or_theme: Track the state changes rather than the switch names.
gate: Verified from initial state 000: middle gives 011 and right gives 111; no single available switch lights all three. Show these exact toggle rules.

editorial_pick.original_reason: A finite lamp puzzle supports a real answer-checking fixture as well as an episode.
editorial_pick.proposed_first_version: Show the legal switch action, allow a fair prediction, then reveal the verified sequence in a calm repeat.
editorial_pick.gate: Exhaustively verify reachable states and the claimed solution. Avoid misleading electrical-wiring realism.
